what: TRIGGER_REASONS lexicographic expectation is internally inconsistent
scenario_or_breakage: Implementer following Cases 5 and 8 will assert `plan-body-lines,diff-lines,files-count` but lexicographic order of tokens is `diff-lines,files-count,plan-body-lines`, so the harness fails until expectations are flipped or the spec drops lexicographic ordering.
suggested_fix: Fix the written test spec to expect `diff-lines,files-count,plan-body-lines` (or stop claiming lexicographic order and document a fixed priority order in the helper and tests).

what: Anti-halt step chain omits new sub-step between 2b and 3
scenario_or_breakage: Orchestrator muscle-memory and audits treat `2b→3` as immediate; Step 2b.5 user prompts and Bash calls risk being skipped as “halt-adjacent” despite being mandatory before Step 3.
suggested_fix: Update the parenthetical to `…→2b→2b.5→3→…` and add one explicit sentence that Step 3 must not start until Step 2b.5 completes (including AskUserQuestion branches).

scenario_or_breakage: `argument-hint`, the “Public argv allows only” sentence, and Step 0b bullet 1 list only legacy flags; new flag is easy to forget at parse/validate time or to drift from `flags.md`.
suggested_fix: Add `-p`/`--partition` to `argument-hint`, extend the allow-list sentence, and include the flag in the Step 0b parse list with the same mutual-exclusion rules as in `references/flags.md`.

scenario_or_breakage: Implementer might `source lib-quiet.sh` from the wrong directory or print KVs to stdout without `emit_kv`, breaking capture under quiet redirection.
suggested_fix: Mirror `emit-plan.sh`: `source "$SCRIPT_DIR/../../../scripts/lib-quiet.sh"`, `larch_quiet_init`, and `emit_kv` for all machine-readable lines.

what: No timing-ledger hook for plan-size sub-step
scenario_or_breakage: Other substeps emit `timing-ledger.sh mark "design Step …"`; omitting 2b.5 hides latency and regresses uniform timing diagnostics.
suggested_fix: Optional: add `mark "design Step 2b.5 — plan size"` after the helper call; add `2b.5` to `skills/design/scripts/step-name-registry.tsv` if downstream tooling expects a row per numbered substep.

what: New public flag not reflected in consumer-facing entrypoints
scenario_or_breakage: Operators discover flags from README or marketplace copy, not only SKILL.md.
suggested_fix: After implementation, extend README Aliases or flag matrix if this repo documents `/design` argv there (defer to follow-up issue if out of scope for #2670).
